answer: Discount trust by graph distance from the established core: each hop multiplies an identity's weight by a decay factor below one, so influence falls off in a tightening spiral the deeper you sit. A sybil farm can only attach past a thin delta of a few real edges, so every fake lives many hops out in the hollow fringe where decay has crushed its weight toward zero. The honest agent, one or two hops from the core, keeps near-full weight; the farm's thousand distant heads sum to a rounding error.
